description: The agents of the sidebar as cards: a small robot acts out each status (types when working, sleeps when idle, waves when it needs you, jumps when done, watches an hourglass while Claude Code waits for background work), with sub-agents, a pin button and a duplicate button. Pick a robot, retro 8-bit, modern or mainframe animation style.

settings.label: Agent cards
settings.hint: Show the agents of the main-dock sidebar as animated cards. Off: the sidebar shows Herdr's own Agents list.

settings.label: Animation
settings.hint: The style of the scene on each card. Robot: the first robot. Retro: an 8-bit robot on an old screen. Modern: a soft orb with rings. Mainframe: punched cards and tape reels of the first computer rooms.

settings.label: Needs you first
settings.hint: Put the agents that need you at the top of the list. The other agents go to the bottom of the panel, under a line. The bell button in the panel header does the same.

settings.label: Waiting status
settings.hint: Show the Claude Code agents that wait for their background subagents or commands as Waiting. The same switch as the Waiting column of kanban.
